listening.title: A check-up call after one month

lines.speaker: Linh (Account Executive)
lines.text: Hello Mr. Hung, this is Linh from SmartOffice. It's a quick check-up call about your new printers.

lines.speaker: Hung (Office Manager)
lines.text: Hi Linh. Good timing. They work well, but one printer on the third floor is very slow.

lines.speaker: Linh (Account Executive)
lines.text: I'm sorry to hear that. Is it slow for every document, or only for big files?

lines.speaker: Hung (Office Manager)
lines.text: Mostly for big PDF files. My staff are not happy.

lines.speaker: Linh (Account Executive)
lines.text: It's still under warranty, so I'll send a technician tomorrow morning at no cost.

lines.speaker: Hung (Office Manager)
lines.text: Great. Also, some new staff don't know how to scan to email.

lines.speaker: Linh (Account Executive)
lines.text: I'll email you the user manual today. Our after-sales service also includes a free training session.

lines.speaker: Hung (Office Manager)
lines.text: Perfect. We may need four more printers for our new branch next month.

lines.speaker: Linh (Account Executive)
lines.text: Thank you, we'd be happy to handle that repeat order. I'll prepare a quote this week.

lines.speaker: Hung (Office Manager)
lines.text: Thanks, Linh. Your team is very quick to help.
